body: Founder: 'add the weatherman and donkey' -> [clarified Donkey owner ambiguity] -> 'donkey should be an item' -> '3.2k flow' -> 'tilda should make the hero do the paper airplane glide thing' -> 'longish range high speed escape can move above obstacles' -> 'long ish cooldown' -> '2 minute cooldown on paper plane fly mode' -> 'but the thing where it unfolds and fights for you thats a passive'. Section 16.1's whole premise -- a new non-piloted companion-unit system -- turned out avoidable: Donkey ships as an item (3200 Flow, Back slot). Immortal's Fold (automatic, HP<25% -> damage floor + fight-back DPS, own proc cooldown) and Paper Glide (tilde-activated, same key as Blink Dagger via new arena_use_active_item dispatcher -- high-speed traversal, flies over obstacles, untargetable, 2-min cooldown) both trigger on whichever hero wears it. Weatherman ships as hero #27: Q knockback (no damage), W grounds/extends Donkey's glide, R AoE zone DPS, passive regen. 16 new tests, full suite green (654/654). Live-verified: isolated 10v10 match, zero crashes, real HP changes across all 20 heroes. docs/HEROES_VS0.md and NORTHSTAR §16 updated. REDGARDEN 664770a (+ CHANGELOG same commit range).
title: S170-206: Weatherman + Donkey, NORTHSTAR §16
